name: RTK Bridge
description: Routes TEDI's built-in AI shell tools through RTK (Rust Token Killer) for 60–90% token savings on git / npm / dev operations. Detects RTK on PATH at activate; if found, registers a shell-command transformer that prefixes every AI-issued command with `rtk `. Disable or uninstall to fully revert. RTK itself must be installed separately by the user.
author: IlhamRiski - ilhamriski.com
